antecedent.defect: The transition lookup occurs only after transformed L is consumed, but v1 later credits signature offset zero and therefore counts a prediction for the already observed L byte. The v1 runner also lacks a source-bound compiler closure, atomic managed lease, resource guard, exact output manifest, and independent decision verifier.

dependencies.required_evidence: A positive v2-format qualification and independent verification under policy v4, including full A/B inverse, probability/state identity, runtime, package, dependency, license, and process-tree peak at most 9,000,000 KiB.
The managed lease and acquisition lock are absent before execution and are acquired atomically by this runner.

contract.role: proof-corrected causal impossibility ceiling for a bounded structural pushdown specialist
contract.semantic_axis_changed: causal scoring and matched-control proof surface only; the D parser, stack, transition key, table geometry, and target-scale threshold remain the v1 mechanism

population.relationship: complete transformed-ready stream from canonical enwik9 through the retained external frontend

parser.tag_end: first transformed N outside single or double quotes
parser.overflow_behavior: abandon the overlong event and suppress retained-stack predictions until ordinary bounded parsing resumes
parser.mismatch_behavior: do not pop on a closing-name mismatch
parser.hash: FNV-1a 64-bit exact name hash followed by frozen SplitMix64 state composition

transition_table.mapping: direct mapped by the low ten bits of the composed key
transition_table.state_key: top parent-name hash, previous completed event hash at current depth, and exact retained depth
transition_table.target: L, optional slash, transformed element name up to sixteen bytes, and N only when contiguous
transition_table.learning: the first observation installs; a different target or key collision poisons the slot permanently

causal_order: Outside an event, transformed L is first consumed as truth; only then may the event key and transition-table record be selected.
A transition target may score only relative offsets one and later. Relative offset zero is structurally forbidden and counted in a dedicated zero-required counter.
Closing-name replay becomes eligible only after both L and slash have been decoded and may score only relative offsets two and later.
For every byte, construct D/R/S/N from state through the previous byte, score against the current truth, then append truth, change quotes, parse completion, table state, stack state, and digests.
No parser completion, actual event length, closing delimiter, later byte, parent probability, archive loss, or control outcome may affect a prediction for the current byte.

arms.K: Execute the exact D parser, lookup, scoring-opportunity construction, table learning, stack mutation, and state digests with prediction disabled.
arms.C: At a decoded L/slash prefix, replay the exact top-of-stack closing name and terminal N.
arms.T: After decoded L, replay the unanimously learned tag signature beginning at relative offset one.
arms.D: Union T and C on exactly causal positions, with T taking overlap priority.
arms.R: On every D-active position, predict the high byte of frozen SplitMix64 over event key, absolute position, and source selector.
arms.S: On every D-active position, cyclically rotate the complete selected D target left by one byte, preserving opportunity set, target length, and byte multiset.
arms.N: On every D-active position, predict D xor 0xff.
arms.repeat: A fresh process must reproduce the complete normalized scan receipt byte-for-byte.

measurements.primary: D correctly predicted bytes, an optimistic one-byte-per-correct-byte ceiling with no probability or archive authority
measurements.chronology: D/R/S/N active and correct counts in three fixed equal transformed-coordinate thirds
measurements.source_attribution: separate C and T active/correct counts plus union-priority counts
measurements.causality: transition offset-zero predictions, closing predictions before relative offset two, score-before-truth transitions, table/stack partitions, and duplicate K/D transition digests
measurements.determinism: input, opportunity, transition, table, stack, and terminal state digests

promotion.minimum_third_margin: D_correct strictly greater than max(R,S,N)_correct in every third
promotion.causal: all causal and transition invariants pass with zero forbidden early predictions
promotion.resources: both scans pass the frozen process-tree, cgroup, CPU, event, and scratch predicates

contract.retirement: Retire the exact 16-byte-name, depth-16, 1,024-entry poisoned-table, exact-closing replay and unanimous-transition mechanism without tuning if correct-byte scale, any chronological control margin, causal verification, or repeat fails. Infrastructure/binding failure authorizes one runner-only correction.

resource_bounds.input_cache_rule: read sequentially with POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED only after bytes have been scored

activation_requirements: The candidate, experiment, execution plan, compiler, runner, verifier, schemas, and q1 policy-v4 closure are content-addressed.
The source-bound q1 v2 verifier is rerun and equals the supplied positive verification before lease acquisition.
The transformed population is fully rehashed before compilation.
Two fresh guarded scanner processes run sequentially under distinct empty cgroup-v2 paths.
No native WIKI-PDA probability or archive integration begins unless this corrected ceiling passes.
claim_boundary: This is a zero-credit causal shadow and never an archive measurement.
Correct bytes are only an impossible eight-bit ceiling; parent surprisal and finite coding can reduce the realizable value arbitrarily.
The external parent and frontend receive zero Gamma authorship and score credit.
No execution is authorized while qm8 or any other full-1G lease owner is live.
